description: Skill output vs hand-written reference. One experiment = one question at one time, possibly several companies; each experiment has its own report reports/{id}.md. Paths are relative to the private workspace (--root). Closed experiments are point-in-time records and are not re-run. Run ids are unique across the whole manifest. split: 'train' runs may be used as evidence for rule changes; 'heldout' runs only judge them (gate.py).

experiments.title: Skill vs human: company-view on TSEM, COHR and FORM (2026-11-22)
experiments.question: Where do the skill's company views agree with the analyst's hand-written views, and what does each side see that the other misses?
experiments.question_zh: skill 生成的公司判断与分析师手写判断哪里一致，双方各自看到了什么对方没看到的？
